lead.headline: Acetaminophen-codeine liquid's generic price jumped 30-fold in 2024; saxagliptin tablets rose 4.2x, then 4.9x
lead.number: Of 308,054 same-unit generic price steps in 2024, 20 were 3x+ up; acetaminophen-codeine solution $0.0145 to $0.434 per mL; saxagliptin 5 mg $1.35 to $6.67.
lead.watch_out: Only 2024's weekly files are loaded, and shortages and makers leaving explain most jumps.

sources.page_context: Pharmacies across the country started experiencing severe month-to-month reimbursement shifts. Here is a rough graph Michael pulled together of the monthly percent change in NADAC based on information available publicly on the CMS website : These shifts were later traced back to a new development: For the first time, a large chain pharmacy participated in the NADAC survey and reported invoice prices across all locations selected. Their acquisition costs were significantly lower than those of other respondents, which lowered the average. However, because their data stayed within two standard deviations, it remained part of the final benchmark. (For those desiring a deeper dive, check out this analysis conducted by 46 Brooklyn .)
